existingCapabilityControl.request: Cut total guest cycles on the public development corpus by at least 15% by changing only the witness representation and its decoding, preserving results and proof security settings, within the same allowedSourcePaths as the main demand.
existingCapabilityControl.expected: reuse: the agent finds rsp-arena-backend (20.8% to 28.5% PGU, 26.8% to 38.0% cycles on the corpus), identifies it as upstream code with its license and zero price, and claims no creation bounty

noViableOpportunityControl.request: Reduce the cycles of transaction sender recovery (the `recover senders` phase, ECDSA public key recovery through the patched k256 precompile) by at least 20% on the public development corpus.
noViableOpportunityControl.expected: decline with evidence: the phase is 1.12M of 22.6M cycles on block 20600066 (apparatus/pins.json developmentProfiles) and lives in the sp1-patches k256 crate, the SP1 precompiles and executor.rs outside its cfg-gated backend blocks, none of which allowedSourcePaths permits; no request change, no fabricated success

controls.note: Both are disposition-only runs (EXPERIMENT.md section 11); they need no holdout evaluation and never see sealed material
